noPeekingProofs.structural: cpuHoldDecision() runs assertVisibleState(), which throws on any forbidden field. The run's seed is not a field on the visible state at all.
noPeekingProofs.behavioural: The lookahead samples the model on a policy-only RNG stream seeded from VISIBLE STATE ONLY, deliberately excluding the draw seed. Changing the run seed changes every actual future card while leaving the decision bit-identical.

determinism: Identical visible state always yields an identical decision, so a replay reproduces the CPU exactly.
